summary: # Marvelous Designer 2025 Shanghai User Conference Highlights ## Video Disclaimer This video is a derivative work of the original video. Any resemblance to actual people, living or dead, is coincidental and unintentional. ## User Experience with AMD ### General Usage I've been using AMD for 15 years. The most common functions I utilize include the basic version function, the line function, some of the big head needles, and internal lines. These are the most basic functions, but I've also been using GPUs and rematches more recently. ### Initial Impressions When I first got in touch with AMD, I was quite surprised. It allowed me to quickly apply the clothing patterns I needed, the clothing styles, and the clothing designs. I can produce results rapidly. Currently, I favor the GPU operation function in AMD the most, as it effectively addresses previous pain points associated with CPU operations. ## Impact on Game Development I've been using AMD for about seven or eight years, and I find it to be particularly useful in game development. It significantly shortens the time required to create high-end models and provides quick calculations. This efficiency liberates designers' creativity during the design process. ## Fabric Flexibility I've been using AMD for about four years. My favorite feature is the flexibility of the fabric. This capability allows for realistic fabric simulations that are difficult to achieve in other 3D software. In AMD, I can imitate effects like hammering, which adds a unique touch to my designs. ## Real-Time Decision Making With nine years of experience using AMD in the field of real-time decision-making assets, I rely on it to solve all my material needs. My favorite function is the calculation feature, which enables me to simulate real-time materials effectively. Additionally, it supports a function called "more target," which I find very interesting. ## Convenience and Efficiency When I first used AMD, I was impressed by how convenient the software was. I could complete tasks quickly and view results immediately. One fun feature is the fan function, which allows me to create dynamic effects like blowing up clothes. Overall, AMD has significantly improved my work efficiency, enabling me to achieve more exquisite and realistic art effects. ## Improvements in the New Version The new version of AMD has greatly enhanced its calculation speed compared to previous iterations. This improvement has made a substantial difference in my workflow. ## User Summit Experience Participating in this user summit has been a fantastic experience. I have seen numerous presentations and user stories that have inspired me. These user cases have generated many ideas on how to improve the software. ## Conclusion Marvelous Designers!
